# Durability and Bookmarks Checklist: Leitura Contínua de Diretórios (010-directory-reading)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality validation checklist ("Unit Tests for English") for directory composite Blake3 fingerprinting, redb schema integrity, 20s heartbeat persistence, offer dialog timing, and resume state machine contracts.
**Created**: 2026-11-03
**Feature**: [specs/010-directory-reading/spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the composite collection fingerprint algorithm completely specified, including exact byte concatenation order (`blake3(fp_0 || fp_1 || ... || fp_n)`), endianness, and handling of zero-byte or unreadable items? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §1.1, Research §Decision 3]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the exact triggers, debounce intervals, and batching constraints for persisting `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS` defined for regular 20s heartbeats, pause events, and chapter transitions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §2]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the offer dialog presentation lifecycle completely specified, including the exact 3.0s auto-dismiss countdown window, default action on timeout, and user dismissal events? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §User Story 2, Research §Decision 3]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the exact mutation semantics completely specified for the "Start over" action (e.g., zeroing chapter index to 0, resetting offset to 0.0, and purging/updating previous redb record)? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 2 Scenario 3, Data Model §2]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the deletion or completion tombstone contract for `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS` fully defined when the directory playback reaches natural completion (`completed`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Data Model §2]
- [ ] CHK006 Is content-drift detection and re-anchoring behavior specified when one or more files in the directory are modified externally after the bookmark was saved? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §Decision 3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the redb table key-value type signature `TableDefinition<&[u8; 32], (u32, f64, u64, u8)>` defined with unambiguous byte representation and serialization rules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §2]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the closed numerical codes for `SessionEnd` (`1 = Paused`, `2 = Interrupted`) clearly specified and bounded to prevent invalid enum casting from disk? [Clarity, Data Model §2]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the distinction between individual file bookmarks in `BOOKMARKS` and collection bookmarks in `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS` specified with clear isolation criteria to avoid double-resume ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Research §Decision 3]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the audible progress threshold required before a chapter bookmark is updated defined (e.g., must audible progress exceed pre-roll silence before persisting)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, AGENTS.md PositionClock]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the resume precision requirement in SC-003 ("100% de precisão na restauração... ao mesmo segundo salvo") quantified with acceptable float tolerance (e.g., `|restored - saved| <= 0.1s`)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003, Spec §User Story 2]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are the state machine transitions between `Closed`, `Scanning`, `AwaitOffer`, and `Playing` consistent between `data-model.md` §3 and the resume algorithm defined in `contracts/resume-algorithm.md`? [Consistency, Data Model §3, AGENTS.md State Management]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the handling of `SessionEnd::Interrupted` vs `SessionEnd::Paused` consistent between single-file and directory resume behaviors (`StartNow` vs `AwaitOffer`)? [Consistency, Data Model §2, Research §Decision 3]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the fingerprint representation (raw `[u8; 32]` in redb vs 64-char lowercase hex string in `DirectoryManifest`) consistently mapped across JNI, Tauri, and Rust storage layers? [Consistency, Data Model §1, Contracts §3.1]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the durability persistence guarantee adhere strictly to the repository architecture (atomic redb write transactions, no uncommitted dirty state on kill)? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context, AGENTS.md State Management]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Is the system behavior specified when redb database access returns a lock poisoning error or disk full condition during bookmark persistence? [Edge Case, Data Model §2, AGENTS.md AppState]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the behavior defined when a directory is reopened after files were reordered or renamed, changing the collection hash but keeping individual file contents intact? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §Decision 3]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the behavior specified when the stored `chapter_index` exceeds the total number of files found during a subsequent scan (e.g., files were deleted externally)? [Edge Case, Data Model §1.3, Data Model §2]
- [ ] CHK019 Is behavior specified when an abrupt OS process termination (SIGKILL) occurs during the exact microsecond of a chapter transition write? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007, AGENTS.md Durability]
- [ ] CHK020 Are migration and coexistence rules specified for cases where a user previously opened a file individually and later opens the containing directory? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, Research §Decision 3]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK021 Is the transaction duration and commit latency for writing to `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS` bounded (e.g., < 15ms) to prevent audio underrun in the player thread? [NFR, Data Model §2]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the redb storage overhead per directory bookmark bounded within tight byte limits (e.g., ≤ 128 bytes per entry)? [NFR, Data Model §2, docs/byte-budget.md]
- [ ] CHK023 Can the 100% resume precision outcome (SC-003) be tested deterministically in headless CI without user interaction? [NFR, Spec §SC-003, Plan §Testing]

## Evaluation Findings & Exact Gaps

- **CHK001 (Composite Fingerprint Algorithm)**: Ambiguous & Incomplete. Spec §FR-008 cites `blake3(fp_1 || fp_2 ...)` whereas Data Model §1.1 uses `blake3(fp_0 || ...)`. Crucially, handling of zero-byte (empty) or unreadable files (I/O errors during background scan) is omitted—it is unspecified whether they are rejected before hashing, hashed as empty slices, or abort collection fingerprint calculation.
- **CHK002 (Persistence Triggers & Heartbeats)**: Missing. Data Model §2 lists writes on deliberate pause, focus loss, chapter change, or app close, but completely omits the repository's mandatory 20s heartbeat persistence while playing. Debounce intervals and batching constraints are not defined.
- **CHK003 (Offer Dialog Lifecycle)**: Incomplete. The state machine in Data Model §3 omits the auto-dismiss timer transition, the default action taken upon countdown expiry, and user dismissal events (outside touch / back navigation).
- **CHK004 (Start Over Mutation Semantics)**: Conflicting & Incomplete. Spec User Story 2 Scenario 3 states "o bookmark anterior é descartado", but Data Model §2 under "Exclusão" only lists natural completion and "Stop", omitting "Start over". It is unspecified whether "Start over" deletes the row from `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS` or overwrites it with chapter index 0 at offset 0.0s.
- **CHK005 (Completion / Tombstone Contract)**: Conflicting. Spec §FR-007 mandates recording individual chapter bookmarks as `completed` ("gravar duravelmente o marcador desse arquivo como concluído (completed)"), yet `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS` only stores a single composite tuple per directory with `SessionEnd` values restricted to Paused and Interrupted. Data Model §2 deletes the directory record upon completion, failing to define any per-file completed status or tombstone schema.
- **CHK006 (Content-Drift & Re-anchoring)**: Conflicting & Missing. Spec Edge Cases claims that adding or modifying files preserves existing bookmarks ("a adição de novos arquivos preserva os marcadores das notas já lidas"), but Research Decision 3 and Data Model §2 define the primary key strictly as the composite hash `blake3(fp_0 || ... || fp_n)`. Modifying or adding any file invalidates the composite key, triggering a cache miss (start from 0.0s). No content-drift detection or re-anchoring mechanism is specified.
- **CHK007 (Redb Serialization & Byte Representation)**: Ambiguous. The 4-tuple `(u32, f64, u64, u8)` is declared in Rust syntax, but binary byte layout, field order, and endianness are neither documented nor specified in the storage contract.
- **CHK008 (SessionEnd Discriminants & Bounding)**: Conflicting & Incomplete. Data Model §2 specifies `1=Paused, 2=Interrupted`, which directly contradicts the existing codebase schema in `crates/session/src/store.rs` (`0=Paused, 1=Stopped, 2=Completed, 3=Interrupted`). Furthermore, no error handling or validation bounds are defined for unexpected byte values read from disk.
- **CHK009 (Isolation between BOOKMARKS and DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS)**: Missing. No isolation or precedence rules are defined when opening a directory containing a file previously opened individually, or vice versa, leaving double-resume behavior undefined.
- **CHK010 (Audible Progress Threshold)**: Conflicting. Spec §FR-007 mandates "salvar imediatamente o início do novo arquivo no banco local (redb)", which violates the repository's fundamental invariant that position advances only on audible progress (`PositionClock`), persisting state during unplayed pre-roll without defining a threshold.
- **CHK011 (Resume Precision Float Tolerance)**: Ambiguous & Conflicting. SC-003 demands "100% de precisão... ao mesmo segundo salvo" without specifying a float tolerance (e.g. `|restored - saved| <= 0.1s`). Additionally, `contracts/resume-algorithm.md` requires snapping to containing-sentence-start and rewinding a 5s context cue, conflicting with "retornando ao mesmo segundo salvo".
- **CHK012 (State Machine Consistency)**: Inconsistent. Data Model §3 uses states `ChapterInitializing`, `OfferDialog`, and `PlayingChapter`, omitting the `AwaitOffer` state referenced in Data Model §2 and failing to reconcile with the canonical `OpenOffer` states in `contracts/resume-algorithm.md`.
- **CHK013 (SessionEnd::Interrupted Handling)**: Conflicting. Data Model §2 specifies that `SessionEnd::Interrupted` initiates immediate playback (`StartNow`), which directly violates the repository's core resume contract (`contracts/storage-schema.md` and `crates/session/src/offer.rs`), where unexpected interruptions require an explicit resume (`ExplicitResume`) and never auto-start.
- **CHK014 (Fingerprint Mapping across Layers)**: Incomplete. Contracts §3.1 defines `fingerprint_hex` as a 64-char hex string in JSON, while Data Model §1 defines `[u8; 32]`. The conversion function, hex validation, and error propagation across the JNI/Tauri boundary are not specified (Contracts §1.3 contains only informal pseudocode in comments).
- **CHK015 (Durability Guarantee & Hard-Kill Replay)**: Incomplete. Because the 20s periodic heartbeat is omitted for directory playback, an abrupt process termination (SIGKILL) during an extended chapter playback would lose all progress within that chapter, violating the repository's guarantee of replaying at most ≤30s after hard kill.
- **CHK016 (Disk Full & Lock Poisoning Handling)**: Missing. Neither the spec nor the data model specifies system behavior, logging, or fallback paths when encountering redb lock poisoning or out-of-disk-space errors during bookmark writes.
- **CHK017 (Reordered/Renamed Files Edge Case)**: Conflicting & Missing. Renaming or reordering files alters natural sort order, changing the composite hash concatenation and discarding stored progress. Spec Edge Cases claims bookmarks are preserved, contradicting the composite hash model without offering any fallback logic.
- **CHK018 (Stale Chapter Index Bounds)**: Missing. System behavior is undefined when the stored `chapter_index` exceeds the number of files discovered in a subsequent scan (e.g., when files are removed externally).
- **CHK019 (SIGKILL during Chapter Transition)**: Ambiguous. Spec §FR-007 describes persisting the completed file and writing the new file start as separate actions, without specifying whether they execute in a single atomic transaction or how recovery resolves if killed mid-transition.
- **CHK020 (Migration & Coexistence Rules)**: Missing. No coexistence or migration semantics are defined between individual file bookmarks (`BOOKMARKS`) and directory collection bookmarks (`DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS`).
- **CHK021 (Write Latency Bounds)**: Missing. No transaction duration or commit latency ceiling (e.g. < 15ms) is specified for `DIRECTORY_BOOKMARKS` writes to prevent player thread audio underruns.
- **CHK022 (Storage Overhead Limits)**: Missing. No byte budget or entry size limits are documented in `data-model.md` or `docs/byte-budget.md` for the directory bookmarks table.
- **CHK023 (Deterministic Headless CI Testability)**: Incomplete. `quickstart.md` Scenario 3 specifies only manual interactive UI steps. No headless automated test harness or CLI command is defined in the plan or spec to verify the SC-003 resume precision criterion in CI.
